---- MODULE Reader603 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Helper603
CONSTANT Limit
VARIABLE n
vars == <<n>>
Init == n = Zero
Advance == /\ n < Limit /\ n' = n + 1
Reset == /\ n = Limit /\ n' = Zero
Poll == UNCHANGED n
Next == Advance \/ Reset \/ Poll
Safe == n \in 0..Limit
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====
